opinions.item: Partial fold and lower mitten clamp
opinions.evaluation: Left palm now reaches the lower flap edge over the sweet; its thumb lobe opposes the palm on the flap. The lowered gold flap reads as a useful partial fold rather than the A12 rear-point hold. Static draft only.
Two quilted mitten contours connect through bent sleeves; the left hand is advanced toward the sweet and the right retains support.
The same red oval remains beneath the flap on the same worktop; no measured inter-source anchor tolerance is claimed.
Single attached crinkled gold sheet and plum contour agree with the specific wrapper. Free flap edge stays readable above the remaining red crescent.
A broad red crescent remains. This is a partial-fold source, not an exact two-thirds-covered or fully closed state.
Same child face, cap, rainbow hair, waistcoat and lavender table remain recognizable in the painted 2D family.
Provisional floor for one partial fold pose. Stronger useful clamp than A12; it cannot pass a continuous fold, neck pinch, opposing twist, release, in-game use or owner acceptance.

qualification: Complete original native directly inspected. Useful partial-fold pose reaches source-only drafting floor4.5 and remains an inclusive priority. Exact requested coverage4.2 is not met. No source-to-motion/runtime/owner acceptance transfer.
